data.exact_reserve_text: A favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.9m (2015: adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2014 year of account reserve movements / Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003
prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) relating to reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding opening balances of GBP 46.298m (2015 closing). During 2016 there was a small favourable prior-year run-off of GBP 0.9m, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and the prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003. This movement represents a release driven by favourable claims development and reinsurance-related adjustments primarily affecting treaty/reinsurance business.
raw_causal_phrases: A favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.9m (2015: adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
In 2016 a large number of catastrophe losses occurred as compared to 2015 where the syndicate benefited from very low levels of attritional losses and claims for natural catastrophes.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts taken from the financial statements presented in GBP 000s (converted to millions). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2015 column = GBP 46,298k). Prior year development is explicitly stated as a favourable run-off of GBP 0.9m (gross) in note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' and used as gross PYD. No specific named catastrophe events quantified for prior years. Claims development triangle (gross) is present and was cross-checked but the movement note is the primary source.
